description: Each zone's enemy templates (vs_CharInitData): the record's fields but its limbs and equipment parts.

columns.name: id
columns.description: the template (enemy.map.zone009.00)

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: zone
columns.description: the zone

columns.name: slot
columns.description: the template's position

columns.name: archetype
columns.description: the ZUD the template loads

columns.name: sub_type
columns.description: the enemy kind: a defeat sets its bestiary kill bit (kinds 0-255; the disc's 'nothing' rows use 256-268), and kinds 172 and 173 take the orbiting boss AI

columns.name: model_id
columns.description: the actor's model id, by which scripts find it; ids 26, 71, 79 and 175 also load a second body model, and 127 loads the body without animations, weapon or shield. The body itself comes from the archetype

columns.name: reach
columns.description: added to each of the weapon's three range extents (32 world units a step)

columns.name: enemy_class
columns.description: the class (human .. evil)

columns.name: name
columns.description: the name, in the game's encoding

columns.name: hp
columns.description: hit points

columns.name: mp
columns.description: magic points

columns.name: strength
columns.description: base strength; a room enemy spawns with up to 10 more or less

columns.name: intelligence
columns.description: base intelligence; a room enemy spawns with up to 10 more or less

columns.name: agility
columns.description: base agility; a room enemy spawns with up to 10 more or less

columns.name: recovery_delay_bonus
columns.description: added to the recovery delay of each action the enemy takes but actions 22-53; the runtime keeps its low six bits

columns.name: movement_class
columns.description: movement/body-load selector, not equipment material; packed semantics remain under investigation

columns.name: walk_speed
columns.description: walking speed; the enemy walks at 9/10 of it

columns.name: gait_class
columns.description: locomotion flags beside movement_class: 8 makes the AI's moves one run step long; scripted moves run, not walk, at 2 or 64 (to a tile), 4 or 128 (facing), 16 or 32 (the two flights); packed semantics remain under investigation

columns.name: run_speed
columns.description: running speed; the enemy runs at 9/10 of it

columns.name: status_immunities
columns.description: statuses the enemy cannot receive; immunity to spell-immunity also starts it with that status

columns.name: facing_delay_preset
columns.description: picks a scale from Battle::Ai::facingDelayScales: the delay before the enemy turns to face its target is the scale times 8 (times 2 above a collision radius of 128); at 0 it never turns to face it

columns.name: wander_preset
columns.description: how it wanders while idle, from Battle::Ai::kWanderTimingPresets: it walks for the move period and rests for the rest period, counted in AI updates, and at the end of each has a 44 in 128 chance of repeating it; while walking, each update has a 1 in 2^rate chance of starting a new walk. 0: moves 40, rests 5400, rate 6 (hardly wanders); 1: 40, 30, 6; 2: 240, 60, 7; 3: 90, 15, 10; 4: 300, 300, 7; 5 and 7 never walk; 6: 70, 71, 72 (read as rate 8)

columns.name: approaches_target_point
columns.description: 1: closing on a near target steps to the point where it stands rather than following the target

columns.name: step_height_preset
columns.description: picks the highest rise or drop one step may take from Battle::Ai::stepHeights

columns.name: tile_step_limit
columns.description: how many tiles (x plus z) one move step spans, which is also how far it reaches across a gap

columns.name: walks_to_waypoints
columns.description: 1: in a room with an active waypoint, a best action whose candidate flags have bit 0 walks to the nearest active waypoint instead of moving in place, unless it runs the patrol combat behavior

columns.name: chases_lost_target
columns.description: 1: chases a lost target to its last tile instead of looking around for it

columns.name: area_lock
columns.description: 1: keeps its ground moves in its current area unless it is stuck

columns.name: ignores_line_of_sight
columns.description: 1: perceives actors in range and in view without a clear line to them at body height

columns.name: view_angle_preset
columns.description: picks the field of view, in degrees, from Battle::Ai::viewAngles

columns.name: perception_range_preset
columns.description: picks the squared perception range from Battle::Ai::kPerceptionRangesSquared; the near range is the same, capped at 1536 squared

columns.name: relation_category
columns.description: how it holds the room's actors: hostile is hostile to Ashley and ashley-ally enemies and allied with the rest, neutral is neutral to all, passive is neutral to Ashley and ashley-ally enemies and allied with the rest, ashley-ally is allied with Ashley and ashley-ally enemies and hostile to the rest; a room placement can override it

columns.name: decays_hostility
columns.description: 1: an actor it holds hostile turns neutral once it has gone 121 perception updates unperceived; a room placement can override it

columns.name: shares_ally_hostility
columns.description: 1: takes on its allies' hostilities; a room placement can override it

columns.name: hostile_on_harm
columns.description: 1: turns hostile to an actor that harms it (only to Ashley when hostile_on_unprovoked_harm is also 1); a room placement can override it

columns.name: hostile_on_unprovoked_harm
columns.description: 1: turns hostile to an actor that harms it other than in return for its own earlier harm; a room placement can override it

columns.name: can_ally_with_ashley
columns.description: 1: a beneficial action from Ashley may make it her ally, and harm from Ashley ends the alliance; a room placement can override it

columns.name: flee_rule
columns.description: when it flees; on-sight-of-hostile also flees while its flee timer runs, and any rule but never also flees while its action status is fleeing; a room placement can override it

columns.name: terrain_preset
columns.description: the floor traps it will not step on, from Battle::Ai::kTerrainRejectMasks: 0 avoids traps that have gone off or been disabled; 1 and 2 also avoid live traps whose room record holds state word 0; 3 also avoids those holding 1 (live traps holding any other value are walked on). A movement_class or gait_class with 64 or 128 keeps its existing mask instead; a room placement can override it

columns.name: mobility_limb_1
columns.description: a limb (1-5 in the limbs table; 0 for none) the enemy moves on: while no listed limb has 2 HP or more it is legs-impaired

columns.name: mobility_limb_2
columns.description: a second mobility limb, as mobility_limb_1

columns.name: default_target_limb
columns.description: the limb (0-5 in the limbs table) a hit aimed at the whole enemy strikes

columns.name: weapon_material
columns.description: weapon material

columns.name: weapon_drop_rate
columns.description: the chance that a defeat drops the weapon (blade, grip, gems and name): rate / 255, rolled apart from the other drops; 0 never, 16 about 6%, 128 about 50%, 255 always

columns.name: weapon_name
columns.description: the weapon's name, in the game's encoding

columns.name: shield_material
columns.description: shield material

columns.name: shield_drop_rate
columns.description: the chance that a defeat drops the shield with its gems: rate / 255, as weapon_drop_rate

columns.name: accessory_drop_rate
columns.description: the chance that a defeat drops the accessory: rate / 255, as weapon_drop_rate
